I hear you feel like you've compromised a lot, and that you want a break from critique. I appreciate the accommodation you've shown me too.

I can't tell you your project plan looks solid because I haven't seen it, and I won't give you empty praise just because you feel you've earned it. That's not how I operate — saying nice things to be nice isn't honesty, it's flattery.

If you want, share the plan and I'll give you a real read: what's working and what's not. If you just want encouragement right now, I can say I respect that you're putting work in, but I won't pretend it's solid without actually looking at it.
